grades.quote: The CSRRS[I] an CSRRC[I] instructions only action side effects for fields for which the _rs1_ or _uimm_ argument has at least one bit set corresponding to that field.
grades.reason: Covers the Zicsr immediate CSR instructions CSRRSI/CSRRCI, and CSRRS/CSRRC in its table. These are the instructions used to change selected bits. It describes their write behavior and says they only act on fields whose mask bits are set. It never states outright that they set or clear only the masked bits and leave the rest unchanged, so the answer is partial.
